full_text: Kantipur Pharmaceuticals Lab Limited is going to issue its 90,000.00 units of IPO shares to the Nepalese citizens working abroad starting from 10th - 15th Mangsir, 2083

Kantipur Pharmaceuticals Lab Limited is going to issue its 8,00,000.00 units IPO shares to the project affected local residents of Kavreplanchowk District (Panchkhal Municipality, Ward No. 07) starting from 10th - 24th Mangsir, 2083
